name: Bag of Holding
description: A cloth sack of plain grey, far roomier inside than out.
body:
## What it does

It opens into a space of its own that holds up to 500 pounds, 64 cubic feet, and it weighs 15 pounds whatever is in it. Reaching in for something takes an action.

## Careful

Overfilled, pierced or torn, it bursts and scatters what it held across the Astral Plane. Put inside another extradimensional space, it tears open a gate to the Astral Plane that swallows both. Breathing creatures inside share 10 minutes of air between them.
